units.source_text: 夜色已深，但冷泉帝回驾，道经前弘徽殿太后宫邸时，觉得未便过门不入，便进去访问。

en.t: It was already late at night, but as Emperor Reizei was returning and passed the residence of the former Kokiden Empress Dowager, he felt it would be improper to go by without stopping, so he went in to pay a visit.

units.source_text: 源氏太政大臣奉陪。

en.t: Genji, the Grand Minister, accompanied him.

units.source_text: 太后大喜，立刻出来相见。

en.t: The Empress Dowager was overjoyed and came out at once to receive them.

units.source_text: 源氏看见太后的样子老得厉害，便忆起了已故的藤壶母后。

en.t: Seeing how terribly aged the Empress Dowager looked, Genji remembered the late Fujitsubo Empress Mother.

units.source_text: 他想：“世间原有这等长寿之人，那么藤壶母后早死真可惜了！”

en.t: He thought, "There truly are people in this world who live so long; how sad it is that the Fujitsubo Empress Mother died so early."

units.source_text: 太后对冷泉帝说：“我年纪这么大，万事都忘记了。

en.t: The Empress Dowager said to Emperor Reizei, "At my great age, I have forgotten everything.

units.source_text: 今天御驾光降，感激之余，我才回想起了桐壶帝当年的旧事。”

en.t: But today, moved by gratitude at Your Majesty's gracious visit, I have at last recalled old memories of Emperor Kiritsubo."

units.source_text: 冷泉帝答道：“自从父皇母后弃养以来，我对春花秋月，亦无心欣赏。

en.t: Emperor Reizei replied, "Ever since my father and mother passed away, I have had no heart even to enjoy the flowers of spring or the moon of autumn.

units.source_text: 今天得见太后，心中始觉欢慰。

en.t: Seeing you today, Empress Dowager, is the first comfort my heart has felt.

units.source_text: 改日再来问候。”

en.t: I will come again another day to inquire after you."

units.source_text: 源氏太政大臣也讲了应有的话，最后说：“以后再来请安。”

en.t: Genji, the Grand Minister, also spoke the proper words for the occasion, and finally said, "I will come again later to pay my respects."

units.source_text: 太后看见源氏匆匆回驾时仪仗之盛大，胸中不免警惕。

en.t: When the Empress Dowager saw the magnificence of Genji's procession as he hurriedly departed, she could not help feeling wary.

units.source_text: 她想：“他回思往日之事，不知作何感想。

en.t: She thought, "When he looks back on the events of the past, I wonder what he feels.

units.source_text: 原来他命中注定有独揽朝纲之权威，是动摇不得的啊！”

en.t: It seems he was destined to possess the authority to control the whole government, and that cannot be shaken."

units.source_text: 她深悔昔日之事。

en.t: She deeply regretted what she had done in the past.

units.source_text: 她的妹妹尚侍胧月夜，闲时也常追思往事，感慨甚多。

en.t: Her younger sister, Oborozukiyo, the Naishi no Kami, also often thought back on the past in idle moments and was filled with many emotions.

units.source_text: 直到现在，每逢适当机会，还时常和源氏通信。

en.t: Even now, whenever a suitable occasion arose, she still frequently exchanged letters with Genji.

units.source_text: 太后常常向冷泉帝奏诉不平，例如对朝廷颁赐年俸、年爵有所不满，或其他种种事情不能称心，此时她就痛恨自己老而不死，以致见此凄凉晚景，便希望回复从前盛时，对万事都觉得讨厌。

en.t: The Empress Dowager often complained to Emperor Reizei, dissatisfied for example with the stipends and ranks granted by the court, or with all sorts of other things that did not go as she wished; at such times she hated herself for growing old without dying, for having to see such a desolate decline, and she longed for the return of her former glory, finding everything hateful.

units.source_text: 原来这太后年纪越大，牢骚越多。

en.t: In truth, the older this Empress Dowager became, the more she complained.

units.source_text: 朱雀院也难于应付，不胜其苦。

en.t: Even the Suzaku Retired Emperor found her hard to deal with and could scarcely bear the strain.
